I build production software, design AI automations that compound, and write for an audience of builders and operators across Web3. If it can be designed, built, and explained clearly, I'm shipping it.

## What I Do

- **Software Development** — full-stack web apps and on-chain products, from prototype to shipped
- **AI Automation** — workflows, agents, and internal tools that remove repetitive work
- **Content & Strategy** — technical writing and threads for an audience of builders

## Featured Work

**[DarkONNET](https://darkonnet.vercel.app/)** — a privacy-preserving prediction market built around encrypted on-chain betting.

**[Xsporty](https://xsporty.xyz/)** — a sports prediction market on X Layer, with an on-site natural-language assistant and a World Cup Telegram bot.

**[Staxxs](https://staxxs.vercel.app/)** — a personal monthly tracker for income, goals, and progress visualization.

## Achievements

🏆 **Winner, OKX LayerX Hackathon S2**
